items.title: Situationer: THE LONG ROAD TO ATTOCK
items.description:
A roughly two-hour drive east from Peshawar brings us to Attock, on the banks of the Indus.
On the Punjab side, the inescapable Att­o­ck fortress, an imposing 16th century structure, dominates the relative lowlands of Khairabad in Khyber Pakh­tun­khwa’s Nows­hera district — the venue of PTI’s renewed campaign to secure the release of their jailed leader, or at the very least seek some relief for him.

items.description:

items.title: Section 144 imposed in Rawalpindi district for a month over 'threat to law and order'
items.description:
The Rawalpindi deputy commissioner on Saturday announced that Section 144 had been imposed in the district for a period of 30 days, over threats to sensitive installations and other critical infrastructure.
Section 144 is a provision in the Code of Criminal Procedure which empowers local authorities to ban public gatherings such as rallies, processions and sit-ins, as well as the open display of weapons.

items.title: Finance minister heads to Bangkok for IMF, World Bank meetings
items.description:
Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb on Saturday departed for Bangkok for the annual International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank Group meetings.
In a statement, the finance ministry said Aurangzeb would lead Pakistan’s delegation to the World Bank Group–IMF annual meetings, scheduled to be held from Oct 12 to 18.
Thailand is preparing to host the IMF-World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok, bringing together more than 15,000 participants from 191 countries, including central bank governors, economic policymakers and business leaders, for discussions on the world economy.

items.title: 10 terrorists killed during CTD operation in Barkhan, says Balochistan govt
items.description:
QUETTA: Ten terrorists were killed in a targeted intelligence-based operation conducted by the Counter-Terrorism Department (CTD) in Balochistan’s Barkhan district, the Home Department said on Saturday.
An aide in the Home Department, Babar Yousafzai, said: “During an intense gun battle, 10 armed terrorists were killed and two CTD officials were injured.”

items.title: Palestinian president postpones legislative elections to September 2027
items.description:
Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas on Saturday postponed legislative elections to September next year, official media said, confirming widespread speculation over the polls which were last held in 2006.
The vote will be held alongside presidential elections on September 11, 2027, Abbas said in a decree, blaming “obstacles” imposed by Israel, according to the Palestinian Wafa news agency.
